messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Action required: nominate purchase owner + security touchpoints for Novaflow pilot

Hi Tom — thanks again for a good conversation this morning. Quick recap and the asks so we can move the pilot paperwork forward: 

1) Economic buyer / purchase owner: you mentioned someone on the finance side may own pilot approvals. Can you confirm who signs PO/commitments for pilots (name + best email)? If Novaflow separates budget vs. contract signatory, please include both.

2) Security & legal gate: we need a primary security contact for SOC2 evidence and a legal contact for a lightweight MSA review (if needed). If you have a standard procurement intake form, can you share?

3) Procurement timeline: you estimated procurement review ~2–3 weeks after nomination. Can you confirm any blackout dates or quarter-end approvals we should avoid?

4) Mutual action plan: attached is a one-page checklist (redwood-econ-buyer-proc-checklist.pdf) with the items we discussed. If you can nominate the purchase owner and security lead this week, we’ll provision the pilot environment and deliver initial evals within 5 business days.

Next step: If you can reply with the names/emails for items (1) and (2) I’ll draft a short mutual action plan and share a DocuSign for the pilot SOW if procurement needs it.

Thanks,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0184

Attachment: redwood-econ-buyer-proc-checklist.pdf

From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@novaflow.io>

Cc: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@novaflow.io>
Date: 2026-10-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Action required: nominate purchase owner + security touchpoints for Novaflow pilot

Thanks Rishi — good summary. Quick answers: 

- Purchase owner: Emily Zhang (Head of Procurement) — emily.zhang@novaflow.io. She owns PO approvals for pilots under $50k. If we go above that, CFO sign-off is required (I can make intros).
- Security contact: I’m looping in Priya Suresh (cc’d below in a separate note) who owns vendor security intake — she’ll confirm SOC2 specifics. For now, Emily will kick off procurement and loop legal if the SOW needs redlines.
- Procurement timeline: Emily typically runs a 7–14 day review for standard pilots; legal adds extra time only if we deviate from their standard SOW. No known blackout dates.

I’ll let Emily reply with any intake form — Emily, can you confirm and share the procurement intake (if any) and best contact for security evidence?

Best,
Tom
Sr Product Manager | Novaflow

1) Emily Zhang (Procurement) — confirm procurement intake form + provide PO routing and billing contact. Target: 2026-10-22.
2) Priya Suresh (Security) — confirm SOC2 evidence scope (we will provide compressed artifact list and a technical contact for a 30-minute evidence review). Target: 2026-10-23.
3) Rishi (Redwood) — send SOW + DocuSign after Emily confirms routing. Target: 2026-10-23.
4) Monica/Kimberly (Redwood) — stand by for pilot provisioning and SSO guidance; we will schedule a 30-minute tech kickoff once PO is in place.

If you can reply with the full names/emails for Priya (security) and the billing contact, I’ll convert this to a short mutual action plan and send a DocuSign link for signatures. If Novaflow prefers the SOW first to decide, we can send that instead — whichever shortens your timeline.

Thanks again — aiming to have infrastructure up and running within 5 business days of PO execution.
